answer: Escrow pays only after a jury grades the submission, so a farm funds work before it sees a return and carries the float through the whole grading window. Failure is published, which turns every rejected cipher into a public mark against the identity and raises the price of the next attempt. Rewards then vest across future epochs, so the payout for a terrace of fakes arrives long after the timber was bought. Budget the attack at one bond per identity plus the float on every ungraded submission.
